headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 3rd**
article:
The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Tim Mayza earned the win after 2.0 IP of relief work. The Washington Nationals fell short in Atlanta, dropping a 2-4 decision to the Braves. Mike Yastrzemski led the Nationals with a home run and 2 RBIs. The St. Louis Cardinals took down the Toronto Blue Jays 5-1, with Jordan Walker leading the offense. Walker's 2-hit performance included a crucial single that scored two runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their team's availability. Zac Gallen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Shawn Armstrong has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a left calf strain. Mitch Keller has been placed on the 60-day injured list with a right arm teres major muscle injury. Connor Seabold, PJ Poulin, Jake Fraley, Lenyn Sosa, and Matt Gage have also been moved to the 60-day injured list due to various injuries.

The trade market has been active, with several moves made in the past 24 hours. Seth Johnson has been traded to the Athletics from the Philadelphia Phillies. The Miami Marlins have traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies have traded Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Fall to Guardians in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians dominated the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-0, securing a shutout victory. Patrick Bailey led the Diamondbacks' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Gallen Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation.

top_news.summary: Seth Johnson, a right-handed pitcher, has been traded to the Athletics. The move comes as a result of a trade with the Philadelphia Phillies.
